Seeking a direction to the Senior Inspector at Mala d Nagar
Police Station, Mumbai to register a First Informat ion Report for
commission of offence under sections 308(5), 351(4)  and 356 of
the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 and for a further  direction to
2nd respondent–Senior Inspector at Malad Nagar Police S tation to
conduct an impartial investigation, the petitioner who claims that
he had a business transaction with Mr. Bharat Bhati a has filed
this writ petition invoking Article 226 of the Cons titution of India
read with section 528 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.
2. In  paragraph  no.5(c)  of  this  writ  petition,  the  p etitioner
states that the accused nos.4 and 5 have filed a fa lse complaint
against  him  with  the  Crime  Branch,  Mira–Bhayander  ma king
allegations of cheating against him. It further app ears that the
petitioner  has  also  lodged  a  First  Information  Repo rt  bearing
No.225 of 2025 on 21 st May 2025 alleging commission of offence

3. In view of the aforesaid complaint/First Informati on Report
lodged by the petitioner against the alleged accuse d persons, no
direction can be issued by this Court at this stage  except to the
extent that 2 nd respondent–Senior Inspector at Malad Nagar Police
Station  shall  examine  the  matter in  an  impartial  ma nner and
record statement of the witnesses and of the petiti oner, if he so
desires.
4. Writ  Petition  No.4702  of  2025  is  disposed  of  with  the
aforesaid directions to 2 nd respondent–Senior Inspector at Malad
Nagar Police Station, Malad, Mumbai.
